title: UZE extension contract
description: A declared extension's manifest as UZE decodes it from `extension.kdl`, and the answer a composed source gives. Protocol 1. Generated from the uze-contract crate by `cargo run --quiet -p uze-contract --features schema --example extension-docs`; do not edit.

wants.description: What the extension asks to reach, in the order written.

exec.description: What a granted program reads beyond the host's own paths, by name.

preferences.description: The settings the operator edits, in the order written.

sprites.description: The frame sheets its `Sprite` nodes play.

icons.description: The icons its `Icon` nodes name beyond the host's own.

mcp.description:
Where the MCP servers its `mcp:` grants call come from, and how long
a call may take, by server.

oneOf.description: Reading files beneath the checkout the surface is on.
Writing text to the clipboard, on a gesture.
Opening a file inside the checkout, on a gesture.
Keeping a store per project.
Keeping one store for the machine, across projects.
Notifying the operator and sounding a cue, rate-limited.
Seeing the workspace's agents and what they do.
Typing a prompt into an agent, on the operator's gesture.
Typing a fixed prompt into an agent on its events, unattended.
Starting an agent's harness on a new conversation.

Keeping a script alive while its surface is open, reading raw keys
when focused.

Running the program of this name, at the path pinned when the
extension was enabled.

Requesting `https://` URLs of this host, and no other, through
`fetch`.
Calling this tool of this MCP server, and no other, through `mcp`.

Grant.description:
What an extension may reach beyond drawing. Only the grants this build
enforces exist here; the decoder names the change that brings any
other.

view.description: The view file, relative to the extension's directory.

band.description: A band's rows and place; `None` for every other slot.

bar.description: A bar item's side and what it opens; `None` for every other slot.

source.description: The source whose data the view is bound to.

title.description:
What the host titles the surface with; the extension's name when
absent.

applies_when.description:
A path inside the checkout the surface needs, as written
(`applies-when=".planning"`): while the checkout it is about has
none there, the surface is neither offered nor drawn.

oneOf.description: The full frame, opened like the built-in surfaces.
A collapsible block of the workspace sidebar.

A panel docked along the right of the agent area, opened by a
gesture and laid beside the pane rather than over it.
One row of the sidebar's header.
Rows reserved along the top or bottom of each agent's pane.
A modal card over the frame, opened by a gesture.
One item of the bar under the agent area, on its left or its right.

Slot.description: Where a surface is drawn. The host owns its geometry.

BandDecl.description: Where a band stands on its pane, and how many rows it takes.

opens.description: A `view` or `drawer` of the same extension.

BarDecl.description:
Where an item of the bar stands, and the surface of its own extension a
click on it opens.

input.description:
What the answer is asked with, by name: text in which `{field}`
refers to a value the host resolves when it asks.

every.description:
How often the source is asked again while a surface showing it is
visible; never under [`EVERY_FLOOR`].

output.description: How a program's standard output is read.

with_store.description: Whether the extension's store is part of what it is asked with.

with_preferences.description:
Whether the extension's preferences are part of what it is asked
with.

deliver.description: How events that ask it again are handed over.

applies_when.description:
A path inside the checkout the source needs: while the checkout it
would be asked about has none there, it is not asked.

oneOf.description: A Rhai file whose `answer(input, context)` returns the envelope.
A program the host runs, confined where the machine can.
A JSON file whose contents are the source's data.
The host's own: the last this many events the extension may see.

The host's own: every agent of the workspace's open spaces, under
`agent:observe`.

A Rhai file kept alive while a surface showing it is open, under
`resident`: `start`, `event`, `input`, `render`, `stop`.

SourceKind.description:
Who answers a source. Every file is relative to the extension's
directory.

timeout.description: Lower than [`PROGRAM_TIME_LIMIT`] when the manifest says so.

Program.description:
A program as a manifest declares it: an argv whose first element is a
path inside the extension or a name an `exec:` grant covers, each later
element a whole argument in which `{field}` is substituted.

oneOf.description:
A file beneath one of these paths, relative to the checkout,
changed.
The checkout's branch, head or working tree changed.

An agent of the workspace did something, as it reported or as the
workspace saw it paint. Needs `agent:observe`.

EventName.description: A reason, other than time, to ask a source again.

AgentEvent.description: What an agent may be seen doing (`extension-agent-bridge`).

oneOf.description: One JSON value, or an envelope around one.
A tree of catalog nodes the host validates and draws.

One item per line, its fields named in order and split at
`separator`, a tab unless the declaration names another, each
trimmed of the spaces around it.

Output.description: How a program's standard output becomes a source's data.

oneOf.description: Coalesced in a short window: it is asked once, with the last.
Asked once per event, in order, a bounded number per window.

Deliver.description: How events that ask a source again reach it.

label.description: What the footer, the action index and a menu call it.

on.description: The surface it is offered on.

key.description: The chord the extension suggests; bound only where it is free.

confirm.description:
The question asked before it runs, with `{field}` references to the
item it runs on. An action without one runs on the gesture.

with.description:
The host-held values it reads beside its item, as written:
`ui.<id>`, `form.<id>` or `form.*` (D24). Only these reach it.

then.description:
What a `run` or a `script` does with its answer once it arrives: a
prompt typed into an agent, shown first, on the gesture that ran it
and never unattended (D16, D24).

ActionDecl.description:
Something an extension offers the operator to do on one of its
surfaces.

KeySuggestion.description:
A chord as a manifest suggests one: `ctrl-r`, `alt-shift-x`, `f5`, `d`.
Modifiers lowercase, joined to the key by `-`; the key a single
printable character or one of [`KeySuggestion::NAMED`].

oneOf.description:
Runs this function of a component's script and applies its
envelope: of the component `file` names, or of the one the action's
surface draws (`extension-components` D4, D10).
Asks these sources again.
Copies this text, with `{field}` references, to the clipboard.

Opens the file at this path, with `{field}` references, inside the
checkout.
Opens this surface of the same extension.

Runs a program, confined where the machine can, and applies the
envelope it answers.

auto.description: Sent on an agent event rather than a gesture.

oneOf.description: Types a prompt into an agent, shown first; never queued.
Starts an agent's harness on a new conversation; always confirmed.
Puts an agent's pane in front.

Does.description: What an action does when it runs.

oneOf.description:
Text, with `{field}` references resolved against the item when the
operator presses it; fixed when unattended.

A skill the agent's harness knows, spelled by its integration, with
its arguments.

The agent the surface stands for: a band's pane's, or the agent the
selected item names.

The agent whose id this `{field}` template resolves to, from the
`agents` source.

AgentTarget.description: Who an agent action is aimed at.

values.description: The values `{arg}` may take; empty for a prompt with none.

AutoPrompt.description:
An unattended prompt: what event sends it, and the closed set its one
argument is taken from, when it has one.

Then.description:
The second step of a two-step action: a prompt whose `{answer.*}`
references read what the first step answered.

ExecDecl.description:
The paths a granted program reads that the host would not otherwise
let it: a device, a driver's directory. Listed on the consent screen.

label.description: What the Extensions screen calls it.

default.description: What it holds until the operator says otherwise.

PreferenceDecl.description: A setting an extension declares and the operator edits.

oneOf.description:
Kept in the operating system's keychain, never shown again, never
read by `{pref.*}` nor handed to a script: only `fetch`'s `secret`
option places it, in a request's header.
Bounds are whole numbers; a value between them may have a fraction.

columns.description: Frames in a row of the sheet.

fallback.description: The state played when the bound one is none of these.

SpriteDecl.description:
A sheet of equal frames and the states that play them
(`extension-media-and-resident`).

looped.description: Whether it starts over at its end, or holds its last frame.

SpriteState.description:
One animation of a sprite: frame indices into the sheet, read left to
right and top to bottom.

nerd.description: One glyph of a Nerd Font's private use area.

unicode.description: One character of Unicode drawn as text, never as an emoji.

ascii.description: One or two printable ASCII characters.

IconDecl.description:
An icon an extension declares, in every glyph set the operator may
choose: the host draws the one their `[appearance] glyphs` names.

plugin.description:
The installed plugin that delivers it, `<plugin>@<marketplace>`;
the extension's own plugin when absent.

timeout.description:
How long one call may take, at most [`MCP_TIMEOUT_MAX`]; the host's
[`MCP_TIMEOUT`] when absent.

McpDecl.description:
`mcp "<server>" plugin="<plugin>@<marketplace>" timeout="5m"`: whose
server an `mcp:` grant calls, when not the extension's own plugin's,
and how long one call may take (`extension-mcp` D2, D7).

store.description: Keys of the extension's store to replace, `null` removing one.

notify.description: A notification the operator is to get, under `notify`.

Envelope.description:
What a source answered: `data`, and optionally the sources to ask
again, a toast and a notice. The strings are the extension's own and
pass through [`crate::Clean`] where the host draws them.

Notification.description:
What a notification says; the host puts the extension's attribution
before its title.

Sound.description:
The cues an answer may ask for. The host sounds each as the
terminal's bell.

IconNode.description: An icon by name, drawn in the glyph set the operator chose: one of the host's (`clock`, `git-branch`, `check`…) or one the manifest declares with `icon`.

role.description: The semantic colour, or `{table:field}` to look one up.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

BoxNode.description: A flex container: its children in a `direction`, `gap` apart, onto a next line when `wrap` and they do not fit, inside `padding`, on a `ground` and within a `border`, every colour a role.

direction.description: How a box's children run: `column` (one under another) or `row`.

wrap.description: In a `row` box, move the children that do not fit onto a next line.

gap.description: Rows (in a `Stack`) or columns (in a `Row`) between children, and in a `Box` both.

width.description: How wide: a number of cells, or `N%` of what holds it.

height.description: How many rows it takes: a chart's bars, a picture's, a sprite's or a box's height.

padding.description: Cells kept free inside the edge, on every side.

padding-x.description: Cells kept free inside the left and right edges.

padding-y.description: Rows kept free inside the top and bottom edges.

justify.description: Where a line of a box's children sits: `start`, `center`, `end`, or `between` them.

ground.description: The role whose hue fills the box; text on it takes an ink chosen to read on it.

tone.description: `solid` draws the ground in the role's hue, `soft` lightens it toward the surface.

border.description: A frame the host draws inside the box: `none`, `line`, `round` or `heavy`.

border-role.description: The role the border is drawn in.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

StackNode.description: Its children one under another, `gap` rows apart.

gap.description: Rows (in a `Stack`) or columns (in a `Row`) between children, and in a `Box` both.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

RowNode.description: Its children side by side, `gap` columns apart; `grow` children share what is left, the rest are placed by `align`.

gap.description: Rows (in a `Stack`) or columns (in a `Row`) between children, and in a `Box` both.

align.description: Where a row with nothing that grows sits: `start`, `center` or `end`.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

TextNode.description: Text in a role, `strong` for emphasis; with `truncate` one line cut with an ellipsis, otherwise a paragraph that wraps.

role.description: The semantic colour, or `{table:field}` to look one up.

truncate.description: One line, cut with an ellipsis, instead of a paragraph that wraps.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

BadgeNode.description: A short label on a ground of its role's colour.

role.description: The semantic colour, or `{table:field}` to look one up.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

MarksNode.description: Role-coloured marks in a row, one per `Mark`.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

MarkNode.description: One mark of a `Marks`, in its role's colour.

role.description: The semantic colour, or `{table:field}` to look one up.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

PipsNode.description: `done` of `total` as a row of filled and empty pips.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

ProgressNode.description: A bar: one fill at `ratio`, or one segment per `Segment`.

role.description: The semantic colour, or `{table:field}` to look one up.

style.description: `block` fills the bar with blocks; `line` draws a thin line over a quiet track.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

SegmentNode.description: One segment of a `Progress`: as wide as its `weight`, filled to its `ratio`, in its role.

weight.description: How wide, relative to the other segments.

role.description: The semantic colour, or `{table:field}` to look one up.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

ListNode.description: Rows repeated over `each`; with an `id`, the host holds which one is selected; `filter="ui.<id>"` keeps the rows whose fields hold what a `Field` has typed.

id.description: The name the host keeps this node's state under, as `ui.<id>`.

empty.description: What to draw when there are no rows.

filter.description: `ui.<id>` of a `Field`: keep only the rows whose fields hold its text.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

TableNode.description: Named columns, one argument per heading; each child `Row` is a line whose children are its cells.

empty.description: What to draw when there are no rows.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

TabsNode.description: A choice the host holds as `ui.<id>`; `show="ui.<id>=<value>"` picks what is drawn under it.

id.description: The name the host keeps this node's state under, as `ui.<id>`.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

TabNode.description: One choice of a `Tabs`: its label, and the `value` `show` compares with.

value.description: What `show` compares the choice with, and what a chosen one is held as.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

ToggleNode.description: A switch the host holds as `ui.<id>`, `on` at first when given.

id.description: The name the host keeps this node's state under, as `ui.<id>`.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

ButtonNode.description: A label that records its `action` with its `item` when pressed.

action.description: The action a press records, by name.

item.description: What the action receives: a field, or `{.}` for the whole item.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

item.description: What the named action receives when it runs.

ActivityNode.description: A mark the host animates while `busy`.

agent.description: The agent whose activity this mark follows.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

ElapsedNode.description: The time since `since`, ticked by the host.

since.description: A timestamp: milliseconds, or an RFC 3339 date.

role.description: The semantic colour, or `{table:field}` to look one up.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

LogNode.description: Lines, each a string or an object with `text` and a `role`.

lines.description: A list field of lines, or one string of several.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

RuleNode.description: A hairline across the width, with its label when given.

role.description: The semantic colour, or `{table:field}` to look one up.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

DetailsNode.description: Key/value pairs, one `Entry` each, with the keys in one aligned column.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

EntryNode.description: One pair of a `Details`: its key, then its value, in its role.

role.description: The semantic colour, or `{table:field}` to look one up.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

MarkdownNode.description: Text written in Markdown: headings, lists, quotes, emphasis and fenced code, wrapped.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

CodeNode.description: A block of code highlighted for its `language`, one row per line, cut rather than wrapped.

language.description: The language the code is highlighted for, such as `rust` or `json`.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

GaugeNode.description: A labelled meter at `ratio`, in `role` until it reaches `warning` or `danger`.

role.description: The semantic colour, or `{table:field}` to look one up.

warning.description: The ratio from which the gauge is drawn in the `warning` role.

danger.description: The ratio from which the gauge is drawn in the `danger` role.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

ChartNode.description: A list of numbers (`series`) as one `sparkline` row or as `bar`s `height` rows tall.

height.description: How many rows it takes: a chart's bars, a picture's, a sprite's or a box's height.

role.description: The semantic colour, or `{table:field}` to look one up.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

StatNode.description: A figure and its label, with a `delta` in its role when given.

delta.description: A change beside the figure, such as `+12%`, in `role`.

role.description: The semantic colour, or `{table:field}` to look one up.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

KbdNode.description: A key, drawn as the workspace draws its own keys.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

GridNode.description: Its children as tiles, in as many columns as fit their `min-width`, row by row.

gap.description: Rows (in a `Stack`) or columns (in a `Row`) between children, and in a `Box` both.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

CellsNode.description: A grid of characters, `rows` a list of rows of `{ch, role}` (or plain text), with `regions` (`{x, y, w, h, action, item}`) running a declared action when clicked. Colour comes from roles only.

rows.description: A list of rows, each a list of `{ch, role}` cells or a plain string.

regions.description: A list of `{x, y, w, h, action, item}`: a click inside runs `action` with `item`.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

ImageNode.description: A picture: a PNG, JPEG or GIF inside the extension, or `scratch:<name>` its program wrote, fitted to `height` rows; `alt` where the terminal draws none.

alt.description: What stands in for the picture where the terminal draws none.

height.description: How many rows it takes: a chart's bars, a picture's, a sprite's or a box's height.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

SpriteNode.description: A declared sprite playing `state` (or its fallback), on the host's clock.

state.description: The state to play: one of the sprite's, or its fallback otherwise.

height.description: How many rows it takes: a chart's bars, a picture's, a sprite's or a box's height.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

SelectNode.description: One of its `Choice`s, held by the host as `ui.<id>`, stepped with its arrows or Enter; the first until one is chosen.

id.description: The name the host keeps this node's state under, as `ui.<id>`.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

ChoiceNode.description: One option of a `Select`: its label, and the `value` held when chosen.

value.description: What `show` compares the choice with, and what a chosen one is held as.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

FieldNode.description: A line of text the host holds as `ui.<id>` while the operator types into it; `placeholder` stands in while it is empty.

id.description: The name the host keeps this node's state under, as `ui.<id>`.

placeholder.description: What the field says while nothing is typed.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

FormNode.description: Its `Field`s and `Select`s, and a button (`submit`) running `action` with them as `form.<id>`, cleaned like any item.

action.description: The action a press records, by name.

submit.description: The form's button label; `Send` when it names none.

item.description: What the action receives: a field, or `{.}` for the whole item.

grow.description: Take a share of what is left of the row.

min-width.description: Never draw narrower than this many columns.

item.description: What the named action receives when it runs.

CatalogNode.description: A node of the catalog, as a composed answer writes it: `type`, then its `args`, `props` and `children`. Every value is a literal; `{x}` in a composed tree is text.

ComposedAnswer.description: What a source with `output "view"` (or a resident script's `render`) answers: a tree of catalog nodes, alone or as the `data` of an envelope.
